jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.description: SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. — we invite you to be part of the solution! About the role As General Counsel, you will lead SoSafe's legal team of lawyers and act as the primary legal advisor to the leadership team. You will own the full legal function, from commercial contracting and data protection to corporate governance and regulatory risk, while acting as a true business partner to Sales, Product, and Information Security. You will also be responsible for all Company Risk and Compliance matters. This is a hands-on, high visibility role for someone who wants to shape legal strategy at a scaling SaaS business, not just execute on it. What you'll do Lead the legal team Manage and coach a team of 3 lawyers, setting clear priorities and fairly distributing work across the team Build a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback within the team Support the professional development of each team member and plan for the team's growth as the business scales Own legal strategy and governance Set the legal team's strategy and goals in line with SoSafe's broader company objectives Elevate on the market’s transition into AI and its application in the legal area Oversee all core legal functions: corporate governance, contracts, compliance and regulatory risk management Provide legal advice and risk assessment across the business, acting as the final point of escalation on legal matters Ensure efficient internal processes and policies are in place and consistently followed Monitor changes in the legislative and regulatory environment across Germany, Austria and Switzerland (and EU wide, e.g. GDPR, NIS2, EU AI Act) and translate these into practical guidance

jobs.title: State (Regional, West)
jobs.description: What is Kalshi ? Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. Role Roadmap Kalshi is looking for someone to own our state-level regulatory and legislative strategy across the Western US. You'll be the person on the ground in your region, building relationships with representatives and regulators, understanding legislative developments, and moving the ball forward in some of our most complex and high-value states. In this role, you'll create the infrastructure, own the relationships, and develop the playbook for how Kalshi operates across CA, OR, WA, ID, MT, WY, AK, and HI. What You'll Do Own state policy strategy across your region: tracking the legislative calendar, identifying opportunities, and sequencing campaigns Monitor regulatory developments and identify initiatives that affect Kalshi Build and maintain relationships with elected and appointed officials, legislative committees, and state agencies to advocate for and educate them about Kalshi's product Draft and shape policy language Travel to priority states and be in the room when it matters What You Bring

jobs.title: Diligence Program Lead
jobs.description: About Upstart At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. The Team: Upstart’s Partner Implementation & Enablement team is responsible for bringing new bank and credit union partners onto our platform and keeping existing partners equipped to run their lending programs. We own the operational core of the partner relationship: the diligence materials partners use to evaluate us, the change management process that tells them when our policies and models change, and the systems that deliver both. jobs.title: (763) Senior Healthcare Fraud Investigator
jobs.description: Company Summary Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future. Position Description: Arlo Solutions is supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Integrity and Compliance (OIC) in standing up and running the VHA Fraud Rapid Response Center ("VA War Room"). The War Room uses data analytics, fraud risk assessment and fast administrative action to protect Veterans and taxpayer dollars, in line with Executive Orders 14395 and 14243. The work gets high-level oversight and reporting to the White House, Congress, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs and the Under Secretary for Health. The Senior Healthcare Fraud Investigator leads healthcare fraud lead and case development from day one, turning analytic leads from VA's Palantir platform into weekly, decision-ready War Room referral packages. The role is advisory and analytical. All final decisions stay with Government personnel. Location: REMOTE - Local to Washington, DC Clearance: Minimum Background Investigation Responsibilities and/or Success Factors: Fraud Lead & Case Development: Review and validate anomalies and prioritized leads from the War Room analytics (including Provider 360, anomaly detection and network analysis). Develop cases for potential community care provider fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) and coordinated billing schemes. Referral Package Development: Build War Room referral packages

jobs.title: Director, Intellectual Property
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We’re looking for a pragmatic, strategic IP expert to join our Legal team. In this role, you will use your experience, expertise, and proactive approach to drive Reddit’s global IP strategy, provide seasoned counsel, and make a big impact on Reddit’s rapidly-growing business. What You’ll Do : Define and continuously evolve Reddit’s worldwide IP litigation strategy, aligning it with Reddit’s product roadmaps, market positioning, risk profile, and long-term business goals. Oversee Reddit’s global IP portfolio, ensuring it is aligned with Reddit’s business priorities and competitive differentiation objectives. Shape and refine Reddit’s international litigation and strategic stance regarding a diverse array of emerging, novel IP matters. Translate complex competitive IP landscapes into actionable strategic recommendations. Be a subject matter expert and provide advice to cross functional partners and Legal team members on copyright, trademark, patent, and trade secret matters. Collaborate with Reddit’s engineering, product, and legal teams, along with outside counsel, to mitigate IP risk, protect Reddit’s brand, business, and innovations, and build Reddit’s patent portfolio. Make smart judgment calls, navigate risks, and creatively manage internal and external challenges on Reddit’s IP matters.
